{{Top|leg}}
A '''Tube Complex''' was a type of [[Complex]] [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]] obstacle used in [[swoopchasing]]. Similar to [[Arena Complex]]es, the Tube tested the rider's skills in close quarters at high speeds with added problems. The [[Bootlegger's Slide]] and [[Otherspace (swoopchasing)|Otherspace]] were both Tube Complexes.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
